WITH latest_signals AS (
    SELECT symbol, date_issued, signal, hit_target, hit_stop, return_pct

),
latest_stages AS (
    SELECT symbol, technical_score, trading_signal
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots

)
SELECT ls.symbol, ls.signal, ls.hit_target, ls.hit_stop, ls.return_pct, st.technical_score, st.trading_signal

sql_templates:
WITH latest_flows AS (
    SELECT trade_date, fii_net_5d, dii_net_5d, flow_signal
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days')
),
latest_regimes AS (
    SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence
    FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days')
),
latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT trade_date, advances, declines, ad_signal
    FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days')
),
latest_indices AS (
    SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close, change_pct
    FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE trade_date >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 days')
)
SELECT f.trade_date, f.flow_signal, r.regime, r.confidence, b.ad_signal, i.change_pct
FROM latest_flows f
JOIN latest_regimes r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN latest_indices i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
WHERE i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
ORDER BY f.trade_date DESC;
synthesis_guidance: Collate and rank risk-on/risk-off interpretations based on synthesized flow, regime, breadth, and index data for clarity in Indian market context.
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 1226
validation_rules: Ensure all evidence table joins use approved _join_rules.
Validate date filters use _global_rules syntax.
Ensure data types match column_details specifications.
